rule: When the user requests a changed World_server plus a link, a progress/status/root-cause report is not a valid final output. Continue through repair, merge, deploy and fresh browser verification until a working canonical link exists, unless an owner-only action is truly required.

ephemeralPreview404.rule: Never return a Netlify deploy-preview, deploy permalink, or other ephemeral provider URL as the final World_server test link. Netlify may be used only as internal build evidence. Final World_server links must pass the Cloudflare exact-revision delivery gate immediately before delivery.
ephemeralPreview404.recovery: Redeploy or re-resolve the exact candidate on Cloudflare, run delivery:verify with the expected SHA and app-ready predicate, then send only the verified Cloudflare URL.
